title: SMOK Nord Pro Replacement Pod
description:
Description
Specifications
Note: Sold individually. Please adjust the quantity to the desired number prior to ordering.
The SMOK Nord Pro Replacement Pod is designed for the SMOK Nord Pro Vape Device. This Nord Pro Replacement Pod has an e-liquid capacity of 3.3ml which is filled via the side rubber stopper. Airflow can be adjusted by rotating the pod 180 degrees and re-inserting it into the device, as the Nord Pro Replacement Pod has two different sized air inlets, one on each side of the pod. The pod has Smart Detection, meaning that your device is protected from short-circuiting if the pod is not fully attached. Best of all, the SMOK Nord Pro Replacement Pod is compatible with both the all new SMOK Nord Pro Series Replacement Coils, as well as the popular SMOK Nord Series Replacement Coils, providing you plenty of flexibility with either direct-lung or mouth-to-lung vaping preferences.
